game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones, standing whisper stones: the scholar mage must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Stat Market: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones: standing whisper stones
core_gameplay_loop: In Whisper Stones, repeat each round: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the profit value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the crypt seal using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The crypt seal reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the crypt seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Stat Market
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stat Market' (Week 7 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Whisper Stones'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Whisper Stones.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The crypt seal reached with actions_used <= 19.
